sentences.text: PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE C.PRATHEEP KUMAR  Wednesday, the 8th day of January 2025 / 18th pousha, 1946
OPMV 274/2018 OF MOTOR ACCIDENTS CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, NEYYATTINKARA APPLICANT/APPELLANT:

MUHAMMAD HARIS, AGED 25 YEARS, S/O.ABDUL MAJEED, MOUNATHU MANZIL,
 NEAR ANOOR MASJID, PASYICHIRA, PALLIPPURAM VILLAGE, MANGALAPURAM  P.O, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM DISTRICT, PIN - 695317

RESPONDENT/RESPONDENTS:
 THE UNITED INDIA INSURANCE CO. LTD, REP. BY ITS MANAGER, HOSPITAL  JUNCTION, NEYYATTINKARA, NEYYATTINKARA P.O, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM , PIN  - 695121  Application praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith the High Court be pleased that the filing delay of 106 days may be condoned in the interest of justice.

This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and the affidavit filed in support thereof, and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.SHYNI DAS J.S., RINU. S. ASWAN, GOPIKA H.H & YADHU S ASWAN,
Advocates for the applicant and Standing Counsel for Respondent, the Court passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2024  in  MACA.No.3938 of 2024  ------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 08th day of January, 2025  ORDER Muhammad Haris vs The United India Insurance Co. Ltd on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88892139/
1 This is an application filed by the appellants praying for condoning the delay of 106 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 106 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioners will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
Standing Counsel takes notice for the respondent.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE SMA 08-01-2025 /True Copy/
